race.comment: CALL ME RHONDA (10) caught the eye with a late run for sixth at Bendigo nearly 4 weeks ago over 1500m, and the extra 480m should suit this consistent mare. Keep her safe. BELLADRAMATIC (12) had trialled up well prior to a poor run fresh up at Seymour on an unsuitable heavy track. The winkers go on, and she can finish a lot closer this time. SAXON BLOOD (4) scored an impressive win at Sale last start when arriving out wide wo score by a length. The extra 263m should be no issue, and he can repeat the dose. BERTRAND (2) strips fitter second up, and he dons the blinkers for the first time. A good draw will also aid his chances, so give him another chance. VISION THING (14) can be excused for her last couple of starts, and she is not the worst in this.
